Create a fingerprint of an objext

Source: R/hash.R
hash.Rd

This function calls digest with the default hashing algorithm as set in the package.

Usage

hash(x, canonical = TRUE, digits = default_digits())

Arguments

x

Object. An arbitrary R object which will be serialized and fingerprinted.

canonical

Boolean. Determines whether the canonical form of the attributes should be used.

digits.

Numeric/Boolean. If FALSE or NULL, no rounding is applied. Otherwise rounding up to the number of digits.

Details

By default, the function hashes a canonical objec representation: Across R versions, attribute order of objects seems not to be consistent, so attributes are sorted by name first. Further, numeric variables are rounded to a given precision.

Examples

hash( c(1,2,3,4,5) )
#> [1] "fa45ce885f810ef9039b80b0edb889fa195a599fb0b7c70ebcd1f4f3cedc220a"
